sections.body: We measure length with a ruler, starting at 0. Short things in centimetres (cm).
A PICTURE GRAPH uses pictures to show numbers. If each 🍎 means 1 child, 4 🍎 means 4 children.
Look at the title and the key to understand a graph.
Measure your pencil, your hand and a spoon with a ruler. Which is longest?
Let your child measure real things. Line the object up with 0, not with the end of the ruler!

quiz.q: Where should you start measuring on a ruler?
hints: Look at the start of the ruler.
The first number on the ruler.
To count your steps you start at zero steps. Measuring starts the same way.
quiz.explain: Always line up the object with 0.

quiz.q: A picture graph: Apples 🍎🍎🍎, Bananas 🍌🍌. Each picture = 1 child. How many more children like apples?
hints: 3 apples and 2 bananas. Find the difference.
If cats had 4 pictures and dogs had 1, cats have 4 − 1 = 3 more.
